AlignMet Begin

Thesis

The world is larger
than where you stand.

Thesis

AlignMet exists because connection was never the hard part. Distance was.

AlignMet helps adults find conversation partners whose needs, skills and interests complement their own, across distance and language. Start by describing what you need or can offer; AlignMet suggests potential partners, and a conversation begins only when both people opt in.

For most of history, the people who could change each other's lives lived too far apart to meet. Not because the world was empty, but because no road ran between them. Rome built roads and the empire followed. The printing press moved knowledge and the Renaissance followed. The telephone moved voices and families stretched across oceans.

Each time, one thing reduced friction: the effort of reaching someone who was not already beside you.

AlignMet makes one more thing closer: the effort of being found by the person who needs exactly what you carry. A question. A skill. A craft. A grief that finally has a witness. Not by shouting louder into a crowd, but by thinning the space between two specific humans until the conversation starts on its own.

The thesis is simple: societies advance when the infrastructure of meeting outruns the limits of where you were born. AlignMet is that infrastructure for the age of connection.

Roads

Every road begins
as a reason to meet.

Rome built roads so armies could move. Trade followed. Then law. Then people who would never have met, met.

Connections

Say what you need.
Or what you can give.

Describe it in your own words. AlignMet searches for people whose needs answer yours, across distance and language, and proposes only the ones worth your time.

A real match

Two people.
Not a crowd.

A match is proposed only when both sides are open to it, and neither has blocked the other. A conversation opens between the two of you, and neither sees a name or a face until you both choose to share.

Guides for the things that matter

Seventeen guides.
One for whatever you carry.

01

Discovery Guide

Stuck on what you want next? Talk it through. We'll reflect back what you mean and tell you when you're ready.

02

Interview Coach

Upload your resume and we'll test every claim. Walk through the work behind each line and find out what still needs proof.

03

Dating Coach

Get a straight read on your profile: weak openers, generic bios, preferences your messages contradict. Expect pushback, not cheerleading.

04

Services Finder

Tell us the problem and we'll narrow it to the right pro. We flag vague scope, hidden fees, and thin reviews before you book.

05

Wellbeing Companion

Describe what's going on and we'll point you to the right kind of help. Not therapy or medical care. In crisis? Call or text 988.

06

Tutor

We find the real gap behind your request, then match you with a tutor who can close it. Intake, not teaching.

07

08

Aspirations

A direction is enough.
You do not need a finish line.

Name the life you are still becoming. AlignMet finds the people who have walked toward the same horizon, and who are walking it now.

Groups

Curiosity gathers.
In rooms, not feeds.

Hiking, books, careers, the odd shared interest. Groups let people who love the same thing find each other, and let real conversation take root.

Group chats

Set the rules.
The room keeps them.

Start a group around anything and write its rules the moment you create it. AlignMet's AI reads every message before it lands, and anything that breaks a rule never reaches the room. No names, no photos, no admins to argue with. Just members, and rules that hold.

Your filter

Never see it.
Anywhere.

Describe what you never want to see. Your filter follows you into every one-on-one chat, every group chat, and every room you create. Matching messages never appear for you, in any form. Everyone else's view stays exactly as it was.

Stores

Search the way you speak.
Find the maker who made it.

Describe what you want in your own words. AlignMet's AI searches every store at once and brings back the makers whose work fits, with prices, reviews, and return windows side by side.

One-on-one

Buy from a person,
not a warehouse.

Talk to the seller directly, ask for the small change, and pay inside AlignMet. Sellers are verified, contact details stay private, and damaged items are always covered.

Trust

Trust is the quiet rule
that lets a stranger say hello.

Everyone is anonymous by default. No username, no name, no photo, unless someone chooses to make a connection and share it. Blocks and reports are always within reach, contact details are kept out of chat, identity is verified, and every member is an adult.

Terms of Service

Every road has rules
that let strangers share it.

Thesis

Roads only worked because everyone agreed how to travel them. Strangers could share them.

Rome did not only lay stone. It set the terms of passage: who could travel, what could be carried, how a dispute would be settled. Trade could only grow once a stranger trusted the road as much as a neighbour.

These terms are the rules of our road. They exist so two people who have never met can meet in good faith, knowing the same rules hold on both sides of the conversation.

Acceptance of Terms

Description of the Service

Our AI helps clarify meaning (while preserving uncertainty) and suggests potential human conversation partners based on stated goals, preferences, and boundaries. Matching requires mutual opt-in. AlignMet does not provide therapy, medical advice, legal advice, or professional counselling.

Privacy Policy

What you carry
is yours to keep.

Thesis

Every advance in connection asked people to give something up. This one should not.

Letters were sealed. Telephone lines were protected. Each time the world grew closer, people needed to know that what they said would reach only the person it was meant for.

AlignMet is built on the same promise. We hold what you share so we can find the right person for you, and for no other reason. Here is exactly what we keep, why, and how you stay in control.

Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy.
What we keep, and why.

What personal data AlignMet collects, how it is used, and the rights you hold over it.

Draft. Last updated: October 2026. Not legal advice. Have a qualified lawyer review and adapt this document before publishing.

Introduction

AlignMet, a product of PlainHand LLC. PlainHand LLC (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and your rights when you use our conversation-matching Service.

Data We Collect

  • Account data: email address, display name, password (hashed), age confirmation.
  • Profile & matching data: free-text descriptions of topics you want to discuss, clarifications you provide, stated goals, preferences, and boundaries.
  • AI interaction data: the messages you send, the AI’s reflections/interpretations (which you can edit), answers to clarifying questions, and any corrections you make.
  • Usage data: pages visited, features used, device/browser type, approximate location (from IP), timestamps.
  • Conversation metadata: when a match is accepted, duration, and post-conversation ratings of “suitability” and “usefulness” (we do not store the private message content of conversations unless required for safety investigations).
  • Communications: messages you send to our support team.

We do not collect special-category data (health, political opinions, etc.) unless you voluntarily include it in a free-text description. You control what you share.

How We Use Your Data

  • To operate the Service (account creation, AI clarification, matching suggestions, mutual opt-in).
  • To improve the AI’s ability to select useful clarifying questions and rank potential partners (using aggregated and, where possible, de-identified data).
  • To send service-related notices and, with your consent, product updates.
  • To detect and prevent abuse, fraud, and safety risks.
  • To comply with legal obligations.

We never sell your personal data.

Legal Bases (where GDPR/UK GDPR applies)

  • Contract performance (providing the Service you request).
  • Legitimate interests (improving matching quality, security, analytics).
  • Consent (optional marketing, certain cookies).
  • Legal obligation.

Sharing of Data

  • Other users: only the information you choose to make visible in your matching profile and what you share directly in conversations.
  • Service providers: trusted processors who help us host, analyse, or support the Service under strict data-processing agreements.
  • Legal requirements: when required by law or to protect rights, safety, or property.
  • Business transfers: in the event of a merger or acquisition, subject to continued protection of your data.

Data Retention

We keep account and matching data for as long as your account is active. After account deletion we delete or anonymise personal data within 30 days, except where we must retain it longer for legal, safety, or dispute-resolution reasons. Aggregated, non-identifiable analytics may be retained longer.

Your Rights

Depending on your location you may have the right to:

  • Access, correct, or delete your personal data.
  • Object to or restrict certain processing.
  • Data portability.
  • Withdraw consent at any time.
  • Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

To exercise these rights, contact privacy@alignmet.com. We will respond within the time required by applicable law.

Security

We use industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your data. No method of transmission or storage is 100 % secure.

International Transfers

If we transfer data outside your country we use appropriate safeguards (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses).

Children

AlignMet is not directed at anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

Changes

We may update this Privacy Policy. We will notify you of material changes via the Service or email.

Contact

Privacy questions: privacy@alignmet.com

Acceptable Use

Open roads stay open
only when travelled well.

Thesis

The road that carried merchants could also carry thieves. Stone never kept it safe. People did.

What kept the old roads open was never the stone. It was the shared understanding of how to travel them, and the certainty that those who broke it would not travel them again.

These are the rules that keep finding each other safe, so that a stranger saying hello is always an act of trust.

Acceptable Use

Acceptable Use.
So finding each other stays safe.

AlignMet is a platform for people to find each other around shared interests, tutoring, work, commerce, support, ideas. These rules exist so that finding each other stays safe.

Who may use AlignMet

You must be eighteen or older. You verify your age by providing a legitimate phone number from a carrier and attesting that you are an adult. Parental controls are the responsibility of parents or guardians, not AlignMet. AlignMet may remove any account it reasonably believes belongs to a minor.

General conduct

You may not use AlignMet to harass, threaten, or intimidate anyone. You may not post hate speech, or content that demeans someone based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or national origin.

You may not attempt to move a conversation off the platform by sharing phone numbers, email addresses, or outside payment details. AlignMet's system blocks these automatically in chat, and repeated attempts may result in suspension.

You may not use the commerce features to sell anything illegal, or to process payments outside of AlignMet's Stripe-powered checkout. All transactions go through the platform.

You may not impersonate another person or organization. Identity verification and age checks exist to prevent this, and bypassing them is grounds for immediate removal.

You may not scrape, reverse-engineer, or overload the platform. You may not use automated tools to create accounts or generate traffic.

Support feature

Support is an AI conversation, not a person. It reads what you type, gauges the emotional tone behind it, and steers the conversation toward growth, intellectually and emotionally. Its purpose is to help you understand where you are and move you toward someone who has lived something close to what you're carrying. Not a professional. A person who relates.

It will not diagnose you. It will not treat you. It will not claim to be human. If you express thoughts of harming yourself or someone else, it will surface crisis resources immediately, 988, text HOME to 741741, or 911, regardless of what state you're in or what the conversation was about before that moment.

Using Support does not create a therapeutic relationship with AlignMet or with any person behind it. What you share is not medical advice and should not be relied on as such.

Enforcement

AlignMet reviews reports and may warn, suspend, or permanently remove accounts. Repeated or severe violations may result in removal without prior warning. AlignMet's decisions under this policy are final. AlignMet reserves the right to determine the severity of any violation and to act accordingly, including immediate removal for conduct it deems harmful regardless of prior history.

Blocks. Reports. No contact details until both choose to share. Identity verified. Age checked. None of it glamorous. All of it the quiet reason a stranger feels safe enough to say hello.

Community Guidelines

A crowd becomes a community
when it keeps its word.

Thesis

Towns grew where roads met. They lasted where people kept faith.

The forum, the market, the town square. Every gathering place that endured had quiet rules that everyone could see and no one had to announce.

These guidelines are those rules. They are how AlignMet stays a place where people come to help each other, and keep coming back.

Community Guidelines

Community Guidelines.
How the quiet rules hold.

AlignMet works because strangers feel safe enough to say hello. These guidelines explain how that safety is kept.

Reporting

If someone violates the Acceptable Use Policy, use the report option in the chat. Reports go to AlignMet's review. You can report harassment, hate speech, impersonation, illegal commerce, or anything that makes you unsafe. You will not be notified of the outcome involving another user's account. Privacy protects everyone in the process.

Blocking

You can block any user at any time. A block prevents matching between you two and hides each other's presence. It does not notify the other person. Blocking is silent and immediate. You will never be connected to that person again. They may never know if they were blocked. They might assume the other person left the platform, or that the match simply expired. That ambiguity is intentional, it protects the person who blocked from confrontation and protects the person who was blocked from retaliating.

If you block someone, existing conversations with them close. You can unblock later from your settings.

Filters

Every user can set a personal filter describing what they don't want to see. When it's on, matching messages are hidden from you alone, in chats and in groups. The sender doesn't know. The other members don't know. It affects only your view. You will never see it.

Groups

Groups form around shared interests. You can create a group and set its rules at formation. There are no group admins. Once the group exists, the rules stand on their own. Group rules are binding inside that group. They cannot contradict platform policy, but they can go further.

If someone breaks a group rule, a flag appears on their side only. The message they tried to send does not appear in the group. It is delivered to AlignMet's review. AlignMet decides the consequence. Depending on the severity of what they typed, that can include a block, matching restrictions, account deletion, or placement in an echo chamber where they may only ever speak with an AI and never to another human being on AlignMet. The user is not told they are in this mode.

AlignMet reserves the right to determine the severity of any violation and to act accordingly, including immediate removal for conduct it deems harmful regardless of prior history.

What you can expect

Respect. Curiosity. Plain speaking. People on AlignMet are here because something they carry meets something someone else seeks. That exchange works best when both sides arrive honestly.

Trust is not announced. It is earned, one conversation at a time, where nobody is watching.

Seller Terms

Seller Terms.
For the things you make.

The rules for listing, selling, and getting paid on AlignMet.

Who These Terms Apply To

These Seller Terms apply to anyone who lists, sells, or delivers goods, services, lessons, or bookings through AlignMet ("Sellers"). They add to the Terms of Service, the Acceptable Use Policy, and the Community Guidelines. If these Seller Terms conflict with the Terms of Service on a selling matter, these Seller Terms apply.

Becoming a Seller

  • You must be at least 18 years old and hold an AlignMet account in good standing.
  • You must complete identity verification and payout onboarding through our payment provider, Stripe, before you can receive payments.
  • The information you give us and Stripe must be accurate and kept up to date.

Listings

  • Describe what you offer honestly: what it is, what it costs, what is included, and when and how it will be delivered.
  • Use only photos, text, and materials you own or have permission to use.
  • You may not list anything illegal, unsafe, counterfeit, or prohibited by the Acceptable Use Policy.
  • We may remove or limit any listing that breaks these rules.

Payments and Fees

  • All payments for listings must go through AlignMet's checkout. Taking payment outside AlignMet for a sale that started on AlignMet is not allowed.
  • Card details are handled by Stripe and never touch AlignMet's servers.
  • AlignMet may charge a service fee on each sale. The current fee is shown to you before you publish a listing. We will give notice before fees change.
  • Payouts are sent to your connected Stripe account on Stripe's payout schedule, less fees, refunds, and chargebacks.

Delivery and Customer Care

  • Deliver what you listed, on time, as described.
  • Respond to buyer messages within a reasonable time.
  • Contact details stay out of chat until both people choose to share them. Do not try to move a buyer off the platform.

Refunds and Disputes

You set your own refund policy, and it is shown on every listing. Depending on the product, your refund window is either 5 days or 15 days from delivery. Whatever your policy says, AlignMet enforces refunds for items that arrive damaged or defective, and may deduct those amounts from your future payouts.

If a buyer opens a chargeback or dispute, you agree to provide the information we or Stripe reasonably request. Amounts refunded or charged back may be deducted from your future payouts.

Taxes

You are responsible for any taxes that apply to your sales, unless the law requires AlignMet or Stripe to collect them. Stripe may issue tax forms where required.

Suspension and Removal

We may pause payouts, remove listings, or suspend selling privileges if we reasonably believe a Seller has broken these terms, poses a safety or fraud risk, or receives a high rate of complaints or disputes.

Changes

We may update these Seller Terms. Material changes will be notified via the Service or email before they take effect.

Contact

Seller questions: sellers@alignmet.com

Refunds

A fair trade
survives a broken promise.

Thesis

Every market that lasted had a way to make things right. Trust is earned in the hard moments.

When goods arrived damaged on the old trade roads, the merchants who thrived were the ones who stood behind what they sold. Reputations were built in the moments that went wrong, not the ones that went right.

Sellers on AlignMet set their own terms. When something arrives broken, we step in. That is how a market stays worth returning to.

Refunds

Refunds.
When something goes wrong.

Every seller on AlignMet sets their own refund policy. When an item arrives damaged, AlignMet steps in and makes it right.

Draft. Last updated: October 2026. Not legal advice. Have a qualified lawyer review and adapt this document before publishing.

Each seller sets their policy

Refunds are set by the seller, and every listing shows its refund policy before you buy. Depending on the product and the seller, the refund window is either 5 days or 15 days from delivery. Some items, such as custom or personalised work, may not be refundable under the seller's policy. The listing will always say so.

Requests that fall under a seller's own policy, such as a change of mind or the wrong size, are handled between you and the seller, on the seller's terms.

Damaged items: AlignMet enforces the refund

If an item arrives damaged or defective, you are entitled to a refund, whatever the seller's policy says. AlignMet enforces this on every order placed through AlignMet checkout.

  • Report the damage from your Orders page within the item's refund window (5 or 15 days from delivery).
  • Include clear photos of the item and the packaging.
  • We review the report and the order. If the damage is confirmed, we issue your refund and recover the amount from the seller.

How to request a refund

  • Message the seller first through AlignMet. Most issues are settled there.
  • If you cannot agree, open a refund request from your Orders page before the refund window closes.
  • We aim to decide on damage claims within 10 business days.

How refunds are paid

Approved refunds go back to your original payment method through Stripe. Depending on your bank, the money can take 5 to 10 business days to appear.

Payments outside AlignMet

Only orders paid through AlignMet checkout are covered. AlignMet cannot recover money paid to a seller any other way.

Chargebacks

Please contact us before filing a chargeback with your bank. Filing one while a refund request is open may delay the outcome.

Your legal rights

This policy does not limit any rights you have under consumer protection law where you live.

Cookie Policy

Cookie Policy.
Only what keeps it working.

The small files that help AlignMet remember you, and the choices you have over them.

Draft. Last updated: October 2026. Not legal advice. Have a qualified lawyer review and adapt this document before publishing.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and understand how it is used.

How AlignMet Uses Cookies

We use the following categories:

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These are essential for the Service to function (e.g., keeping you logged in, security, load balancing). They cannot be switched off in our systems.

Performance / Analytics Cookies

These help us understand how visitors use AlignMet (pages visited, features used, error rates) so we can improve the product. Data is aggregated and, where possible, anonymised.

Functionality Cookies

These remember choices you make (e.g., language, previous clarification settings) to provide a more personalised experience.

Targeting / Marketing Cookies (if used)

We currently do not use third-party advertising or targeting cookies. If this changes we will update this policy and obtain any required consent.

Managing Cookies

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies. Note that blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent parts of AlignMet from working.

Where required by law we will show a cookie consent banner on your first visit and let you choose which optional categories to accept.

Third-Party Cookies

Changes

Accessibility

A road is only open
if everyone can travel it.

Thesis

Every barrier removed in history widened who could take part. The world grew by letting more people in.

Print brought knowledge to people who could not reach a library. The telephone brought voices to people who could not travel. Each step made the world larger by making it reachable.

AlignMet is meant for everyone who carries a question or an answer. Here is where we stand today, and where we are still building.

Accessibility

Accessibility.
Open to everyone.

AlignMet is committed to making the platform usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.

The goal is conformance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.2, level AA.

Known limitations exist. The Draftbit React Native framework that powers the app has accessibility gaps in some components, missing labels, insufficient color contrast in certain themes, and keyboard navigation issues on specific screens. AlignMet is actively working to identify and fix these.

If you encounter an accessibility barrier, report it through the Contact page or email accessibility@alignmet.com. AlignMet will respond and work toward a resolution.

AlignMet does not claim the app is fully accessible today. It claims the commitment to get there, and the honesty to say where it isn't yet.

runs both ways.

Connection was never meant to travel in one direction. You should reach us as easily as we reach you.

We built AlignMet so the right person could find you. It is only right that you can find us just as easily, with a question, a report, an idea, or a story.

Choose a topic and your message goes straight to the people who can help. Every message is read.
